decisions.reason: Correctly locates inject=["apiProxy"] (index.js:3) and ctx.apiProxy.llm.providers() (index.js:9), explains the service-access break and the dead dsh-host-apiproxy@0.0.1-rc.1 pin, and proposes re-deriving the service id/call from the 0.1.2 registry; but never names card A1-01 nor the concrete llm-injection/listProviders target form, so the mapping requirement is only met by subject-matter inference.

All six other categories covered with per-file line evidence; session-notes.js correctly read as a pure string/array utility and cordis.patch.yml treated as ordinary composition, not a host-source patch, without denying its existence.

§4 argues at length that zero static hits are a bounded negative — coverage limits, package/runtime/semantic behavior outside scan reach — and cleanly separates the decisive apiProxy hit from the six negative categories.
§6 specifies post-migration install/build/typecheck, an isolated-profile cold boot checking no service-not-found/pending, and a real providers() payload check, all marked as proposed, not executed.
